summary.headline: GRE Renew H1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose about 75% YoY to INR 139 CR, but margins compressed on a low-margin 65 MW back-to-back EPC project.
summary.overview: Management reported H1 FY27 consolidated revenue of about INR 139 CR, with solar EPC contributing INR 129 CR (about 93%). Profit grew strongly, but EBITDA margin came under pressure because a large back-to-back project, about 48% of H1 revenue, was executed at a lower margin to build utility-scale EPC credentials. Management said margins should stay pressured until that project completes, and that healthy-margin projects would be taken going forward. The transcript is partly garbled (automated transcription), so several figures, including the exact margins and growth rates, could not be verified and should be checked against the filing.

financial_highlights.change: approx. 75% YoY as stated (growth percentages are garbled in transcript)

financial_highlights.value: INR 129 CR, approx. 93% of consolidated revenue

financial_highlights.change: Management said strong growth in absolute profitability

financial_highlights.value: Figure garbled in transcript (around 4-6% per partial readout)
financial_highlights.change: Compressed versus prior year (about 9.13% as partially transcribed)

financial_highlights.value: Approx. 33% revenue, 131% and 141% for EBITDA and PAT as transcribed
INR 50 CR via loan; limit enhanced to INR 5 CR; new term loan INR 2.58 CR (as transcribed)

segments.name: Solar EPC
segments.commentary: Primary growth driver with INR 129 CR in H1 FY27, about 93% of consolidated revenue. Margin dilution is attributed to a back-to-back project covering about 48% of H1 revenue, executed at lower margin.

segments.name: IPP / Power sale (RESCO/PPA)
segments.commentary: Revenue from sale of power is small (about INR 2.33 CR as transcribed) but recurring for up to 25 years. Management said the portfolio is growing, with about 15 MW operating and 10-11 MW under construction.

segments.name: O&M
segments.commentary: Management positions O&M as recurring 25-year income on its own projects. A specialised O&M team and SOP exist; a 3-year O&M contract is tied to a INR 175 CR project (as transcribed).

segments.name: LED / Others
segments.commentary: LED segment turnover is about INR 1.5-3 CR (as transcribed). Management said it will not grow this segment and will focus on solar.

guidance_outlook: Margins expected to stay under pressure until the low-margin back-to-back project is completed, likely into H2 FY27.
Management said it would maintain healthy margins on new projects as the business grows; no numeric margin guidance was given.
Funding model is about 25% internal accruals and 75% bank debt per project; debt share expected to rise as RESCO portfolio grows.
Management declined to give FY28/FY29 capacity targets ('futuristic' figures not provided).
Order book conversion of 20-80% was mentioned for execution in FY27 (as transcribed; unclear).
capex_capacity: Operating IPP capacity about 15 MW, with about 10-11 MW under construction (as transcribed; prior-year reference of 3.8 MW in FY26 was in the question).
Pipeline includes a 65 MW project (Maharashtra tender, back-to-back subcontract) with low margin; a 50 MW AC / 65 MW DC project cost of about INR 175 CR (transcribed).
Management said it had identified no new land and connectivity figures for FY28-29 beyond current pipeline.
Use of IPO proceeds: about INR 25.85 CR deployed on solar projects (as transcribed).
demand_pricing: Management said ground-mount economics beat rooftop because of higher generation per MW and lower competition at scale; rooftop viable only for larger sites.
Third-party/C&I power sale model: discount to grid tariff around INR 1.5 per unit; PPA management charge of 20-25% (15% for large orders) as stated.
Management noted Rajasthan expansion beyond Gujarat with early market response.
BESS: entry pending Gujarat GERC policy finalisation; pilot R&D under way. Management said it would enter BESS as soon as policy is notified.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capacity target for FY28 and FY29 and how much new land and connectivity has been identified?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 15 MW is running as IPP, with 10-11 MW under construction; it declined to give forward figures.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the order book will be executed in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 20-80% of the order book could convert in FY27 (transcript unclear).

qa_highlights.question: Why did trade receivables and payables both rise sharply, reaching about 106 days?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the increase is project-specific (65 MW project) and that receivables and payables are matched, so net working capital impact is limited.

qa_highlights.question: Is the H1 margin pressure due to the large solar EPC project or other factors?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the pressure is from the low-margin project that runs through H1 and into the next half; new projects are being taken at healthy margins.

qa_highlights.question: How do rooftop economics compare with ground-mount, and what returns are evaluated?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ground-mount gives more generation per MW and rooftop is only viable on larger sites; unit economics favour ground-mount for the company.

qa_highlights.question: How will expansion be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the model is 25% internal accruals and 75% bank debt, with debt rising as RESCO grows.

qa_highlights.question: Is O&M for third parties planned, and what is the O&M revenue outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said O&M is mainly for own customers for quality and retention, with third-party O&M not the focus; a 3-year O&M contract is in hand on one project.

risks_watch: Margin dilution: low-margin back-to-back project (about 48% of H1 revenue) may keep EBITDA margin under pressure in H2 FY27.
Working capital: receivables and payables both rose sharply (cited around 106 days); watch collection on the 65 MW project.
Debt load: model relies on about 75% bank debt per project, so leverage rises as RESCO grows.
BESS entry depends on Gujarat GERC policy notification; timing is uncertain.
Transcript quality is poor; key figures (margins, growth rates, PAT, order book) should be verified from the filing before use.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and the RESCO/O&M model, but cautious and somewhat evasive on margins and forward capacity, declining to give FY28/FY29 targets. Management acknowledged margin pressure as a deliberate trade-off for entering utility-scale EPC.
key_quotes: Our margins were impacted by the large back-to-back project involving approximately 48% of the first half year revenue, which was executed at a lower margin to establish our execution credentials in the utility scale solar segment.
As my business is growing I will maintain my margins as well.
